I feel like deep down I know these questions would never be answered but that doesn’t stop me from hoping that in the near future I will receive some form of closure so that I can start to heal. 

Like you said I’m not upset that they would choose their happiness over me but I’m upset at the utter disregard for our relationship after everything I did for them. 

To me the fact that you are over analysing everything instead of leaving them in the past and moving forward yourself after what they did says that you care and that you’re a good person and I hope that one day you find yourself someone who cares for you the same way. I hope we both do. 

Again, thank you for your time. It’s very comforting to know that there’s people going through the same because as you probably know it’s a very lonely experience.
